title: Bollywood Bonus
tagline: Hits from the 90s and 2000s. Never heard them? Guess anyway.
howTo: A Bollywood clip plays on the TV.
Tap the right answer. Faster right answers score more.

questions.question: This is "Chaiyya Chaiyya" from 1998. Its famous dance scene was filmed on top of a moving what?

itunes.term: Chaiyya Chaiyya Dil Se Sukhwinder Singh

questions.fact: Shah Rukh Khan danced on the roof of a moving train.

questions.question: This hit is called "Kal Ho Naa Ho". What does the title mean?

itunes.term: Kal Ho Naa Ho Sonu Nigam

questions.fact: It is the title song of a 2003 film set in New York City.

questions.question: This is the title song of "Kuch Kuch Hota Hai". What does that phrase roughly mean?

itunes.term: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai title song

questions.fact: As in: something happens in my heart. The film came out in 1998.

questions.question: This love song comes from a 1995 film that has played in one Mumbai theater ever since. How long is that?

itunes.term: Tujhe Dekha To Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge

questions.fact: The film is Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge, known to fans as DDLJ.

questions.question: "Jai Ho" won an Oscar for Best Original Song. Which film is it from?

itunes.term: Jai Ho A.R. Rahman Slumdog Millionaire

questions.fact: Composer A.R. Rahman took home two Oscars that night.

questions.question: This wedding favorite is "Bole Chudiyan". What are chudiyan?

itunes.term: Bole Chudiyan Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham

questions.fact: The title means "the bangles say". It is from Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (2001).

questions.question: This is "Dhoom Machale" from the 2004 action hit Dhoom. What do the film's thieves escape on?
This song, "Mehndi Laga Ke Rakhna", is played at weddings. What is mehndi?

itunes.term: Mehndi Laga Ke Rakhna Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge

questions.fact: Brides have henna designs painted on their hands before the wedding.

questions.question: This is the title song of "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham". What does that title mean?

itunes.term: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham title song Lata Mangeshkar

questions.question: Lots of Bollywood songs have the word "dil" in the title. What does dil mean?

itunes.term: Dil Chahta Hai title song Shankar Mahadevan

questions.fact: This one is "Dil Chahta Hai": the heart wants.

Which actor is known as "King Khan", the King of Bollywood?
